newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH aims for sales, profit growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: LVMH aims for sales, profit growth in 1997.

text.p: Luxury goods group LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton said on Thursday it expected growth in all its businesses in 1997 and a positive impact from favourable dollar and sterling exchange rates.

It said its acquisition of a controlling stake in U.S. duty free chain DFS would boost growth in the Asia-Pacific region and have a positive contribution on LVMH's cash flow and profit excluding goodwill amortisation and exceptionals this year.
"These elements allow us to set an objective for 1997 of further growth in profit and turnover of the group LVMH," it said in a statement.
It said one negative element this year was the yen's low level against the dollar.
